The repair should name a route that adds information, such as /doctor:setup, whose embedder leg reports the same coverage and backend state.

When the backend is reachable but coverage is incomplete, report the stale and missing counts for skills and commands and say the daemon refreshes them on its next start with Ollama up. critic_override.note: The embedder route is the only route that starts the server and pulls the model (doctor-skill-advisor-embedder.yaml phase_4_approved_steps), so pointing back to it is the retry path for an unreachable backend. The proposed replacement, /doctor:setup, is read-only: doctor/setup.md says it "writes nothing in the repository and never starts the advisor daemon", so it cannot repair an unreachable backend. The lane's fix would also make the YAML disagree with the presentation's Next line (doctor-skill-advisor-presentation.txt:300), which the lane itself cites.
